method: One recorded action, preparation, material variant, time-bound ecclesiastical policy, or place-specific sequence per row. Linked to exact HTML witness URL and displayed line. 2024/2025 programmes prove those specific editions only, not continuous historical observance or adherence to 1962 rubrics. Some rows share one paragraph or describe a single larger processional sequence: never infer distinct custom count. Legend, origin report, contemporary parish rite and secular guild event tagged separately. The Enna municipal Domenica in Albis page mixes Easter and Octave details: keep chronology explicitly ambiguous and check later.
